title: The Thief and His Monkey
logline: A thief whose monkey distracts the crowd steals a bundle that turns out to be rags, dresses it in costly cloth and sells it unopened to a buyer who learns from his wife, too late, what he has paid for.
moral: Do not buy what you have not seen: a fine wrapping and a low price are the mark of a trick, and stolen or unknown goods cost more than they are worth.
tone: Light market comedy of misdirection. Sly rather than cruel: the fun is in watching where everyone looks. A quiet, rueful ending with no gloating.

beats.summary: A man who lives by stealing: introduced with a THIEF label and a look to camera.
His trained monkey: three tricks that pull every eye.
The method: eyes go to the monkey, his eyes go to the purses.
He spots the old-clothes seller, whom nobody buys from.
The tired seller ties the bundle and sets it at his side.
The seller laughs at the monkey and turns his back on the bundle.
The steal, after one false alarm.
The prize is only rags: the thief is cheated by his own theft.
The idea: a costly cloth outside, rags inside.
The strange rule: no opening before paying.
Why it works: people imagine treasure in a closed bundle.
The buyer pays three coins without looking inside.
His wife asks the two questions he never asked himself.
The thief leaves with the money and the monkey.
The buyer is left with old clothes worth less than he paid.

cast.name: the thief
cast.look: Unmasked street trickster, clearly different from the masked Moonbeam thief: red flat cap, black tunic with white dots (pal robe #141414, dot #fffaf0), yellow sash, black moustache, age 0.2, s 1.25. Default face: lid 0.45, brow -0.4 (sly), smirk. A friendly 'mask' face (big smile, brows up) whenever a victim looks at him.

cast.name: the trained monkey
cast.base: Library monkey, s 0.7, plus a small red fez drawn by the scene

cast.name: the old-clothes seller
cast.look: Frayed cap, brown tunic with pale apron, grey moustache, slight stoop. Hopeful at first, then worn out, then delighted by the monkey.

cast.name: the buyer
cast.base: person costume:'merchant' with the green palette shown in people.png ('merchant pal')
cast.look: Green robe, big yellow turban with a red jewel, black beard, s 1.3: prosperous and pleased with himself. Blue is avoided so he never merges with the caption colour.

cast.name: the buyer's wife
cast.look: Yellow headscarf, red dress, s 1.25. Calm, sharp eyes; the cleverest person in the film. Red against his green keeps the two apart at phone size.

cast.name: market people (3 to 5 on screen)
cast.look: A small fixed set of five extras reused in both markets with different positions; each has its own blink seed, walk speed and reaction delay. Each wears a small purse on the sash in S1 and S2.

sets.description: The planned 'marketStreet' set, variant A, world 1800 x 1230, ground y 900. Back wall of flat-roofed sand houses from y 300 to 880 with three arches; two stalls (each 320 wide, counter top y 780, striped awning top y 520, two posts): fruit at x 250 (red and white) and cloth at x 780 (yellow and red, right post at x 960), with a few pots on the ground at x 1010. The seller corner for S3 to S6 is the open ground x 1000..1700 right of that post, in front of a plain wall with one arch. Sky by skyCycle. Approximate marks; measure on the set once drawn.

The same 'marketStreet' function, variant B, so it reads as another market: mirrored layout, blue and yellow awnings, a dome and a palm above the roof line, later sun (skyCycle u 0.3). Display crate at x 500 (top y 800). The street runs on to a house front with a door (150 x 300) at x 1640 for S12.

The 'marketStreet' function with option alley:true: no stalls, two high blank walls (to y 120) in shadow tone, one dark arch at x 820, a washing line from (80, 260) to (920, 300) with three cloths that swing, a crate at x 500 (180 wide, top y 820) and a barrel at x 660 (top y 790). World 1000 x 1230.

The planned 'palaceHall' set, variant merchantHouse: plain arched interior 1000 x 1230, ochre wall with red dot shading, one window at (780, 380) with dusk light, door at x 150 (150 x 320), tiled floor from y 900, a shelf with three jars at y 420, a low table at x 520 (220 wide, top y 800) and a stool at x 720 for the wife (and one at x 400 for the ending).
Library skyCycle(u 0.45) + hillTrees + ground, with a tiny silhouette of the market domes (two arcs and a palm, 160 wide) on the horizon at x 200 drawn by the scene.

props.description: clothBundle: a knotted cloth bundle about 150 wide x 120 tall at s 1 with a top knot (two ears 40 long). Fields: wrap 'plain' (grey-brown, two patches) or 'rich' (red with yellow diamonds, gold fringe, gold cord and tassel), open 0..1 (four corners fall flat one at a time to a 260-wide cloth showing the contents), contents 'rags' or 'treasure', sq, peek 0..1 (one corner lifted with a sleeve hanging out).

Part of the clothBundle module: a heap of 5 drab garments (shirt with two patches and a 30-unit hole, trousers, robe, cap, sock) plus the single shirt (160 x 150) that can be held up by two hand points.
The 'rich' wrap as a flat cloth 240 x 240: red, yellow diamond grid (6 x 6), 14-unit gold fringe; unfurl 0..1 with a travelling edge wave.
The planned 'coinPile' with n coins (single coins usable alone): yellow discs r 14 with a black rim and a red dot; heap up to 30.
noPeekSign: board 200 x 130 on a 260 post; front shows a black eye icon crossed by a red bar and the words NO PEEKING! (Bangers, 44 px minimum on the 1280 scale); flip 0..1.
Two pale triangles (wings, 14 units) and a dot, flapping at 12 Hz on a seeded zigzag path; used three times (26.38, 70.86, 163.86) as the running gag that marks the same old clothes.
Three Library figs for the juggling.

scenes.composition: Thief x 330, bundle on the crate x 500, buyer arrives at x 680 (s 1.3, green merchant). Buyer thought cloud 480 x 320 at (700, 330), tail to his head. Coins travel from his hand at (610, 760) to the thief palm at (410, 760).

actions.action: Strolls in from the right, passing the stall, and stops short when he sees the bundle
actions.acting: the stop has a one-step overshoot; brows up

actions.action: Arrow and label 'BUYER'
actions.acting: he straightens his turban

actions.action: His gaze locks on the cloth; he comes one step closer
actions.acting: pupils fixed on the bundle; the other onlookers drift out of frame

actions.action: Bends to look closely; a glint runs over the fringe
actions.acting: tip 0.12, hands behind his back

actions.action: Strokes the cloth with one finger; the thief watches the finger, ready to block
actions.acting: thief hand hovers 20 units above the bundle

actions.action: Straightens up delighted; a small heart pops over the bundle
actions.acting: smile, brows up, a happy sway; thief and monkey trade a quick look

actions.action: Hand to his chin, eyes up; his own thought cloud pops
actions.acting: thinking saccades

actions.action: In the cloud: 3 coins on the left, an arrow, and the bundle on the right
actions.acting: the three coins drop in one by one

actions.action: The bundle in the cloud turns into a coin heap that grows to ten times the three coins
actions.acting: heap grows with overshoot; counter in the cloud runs 3 to 30

actions.action: Rubs his hands; the cloud pops away
actions.acting: eyes shut in bliss for 8 frames, then decision: a firm nod

actions.action: He counts three coins into the thief palm: 1, 2, 3
actions.acting: each coin a small arc; thief fingers close on the third

actions.action: Hands the bundle over with both hands and a bow
actions.acting: bow tip 0.2; buyer takes the weight (arms dip 6 px)

actions.action: His fingers go to the knot to peek; the thief points at the sign; the fingers come away
actions.acting: buyer shrugs and smiles: fine

actions.action: Stamp 'NOT CHECKED' with a red X over a small eye icon, upper left
actions.acting: stamp lands with a 2-frame squash

actions.action: Hugs the bundle to his chest
actions.acting: cheek against the cloth, eyes shut

scenes.summary: He carries it home dreaming of a big profit, while behind him the thief counts the coins.

camera.notes: Track right with the buyer from x 680 to x 1500 (zoom 1.2, y 660) so the thought cloud above him stays in frame; the thief and monkey slide out on the left.

scenes.composition: Buyer walks on y 900 with the bundle in both arms. Cloud 420 x 280 follows 300 units above his head, a beat late. His house door stands at x 1640 (door 150 x 300, yellow light inside).

actions.action: Turns and walks off right with the bundle
actions.acting: springy proud walk, bundle bobbing a beat late

actions.action: Behind him the thief kisses the coins and the monkey rubs its hands, then both slip out left
actions.acting: small and in the background; clear silhouette

actions.action: His house door comes into view at the right edge
actions.acting: warm yellow light in the doorway

actions.action: A thought cloud trails above him as he walks
actions.acting: cloud lags his head by 3 frames

actions.action: In the cloud a small buyer hands the bundle to a rich customer
actions.acting: two small figures, at least 110 px tall on screen

actions.action: Coins rain into the small buyer arms
actions.acting: 6 coins on seeded arcs

actions.action: The coin heap in the cloud grows taller than he is; the real buyer skips through his door
actions.acting: one hop with landSquash on the threshold

scenes.summary: At home his wife asks what he bought; he boasts about the low price and the profit to come.

camera.notes: twoShot(buyer, wife): zoom 1.25 centred x 520, y 700. Static, so the acting carries the scene.

scenes.composition: Merchant house interior. Door at x 150. Low table at x 520 (top y 800, 220 wide) with the bundle on it. Buyer at x 360, wife rises from a stool at x 720 (s 1.25). Icon balloons appear above the speaker side, never over a face.

actions.action: Comes in through the door and sets the bundle on the table with both hands, like a trophy
actions.acting: chest out, proud smile; a little flourish as he lets go

actions.action: Looks up from her mending on the stool
actions.acting: needle hand stops in the air; gaze goes to the bundle, then to him

actions.action: Stands and points at the bundle
actions.acting: sit 1 to 0 with a settle; talk on; head tilt

actions.action: One brow up, waiting for the answer; a small ? balloon
actions.acting: brow -0.5, mouth closed, hand on hip

actions.action: Talks with a hand on his chest
actions.acting: sq 1.04 puffed, rocking on his heels

actions.action: Shows three fingers; a balloon shows three small coins
actions.acting: gleeful, eyes on her to see the effect

actions.action: Pinches the air: so little
actions.acting: squint, pinched fingers near his eye

actions.action: Spreads both arms wide; the balloon swaps to a big coin heap
actions.acting: anticipate, then armsOut with overshoot

actions.action: She looks from the heap balloon to the bundle to him; her brow sinks and her arms fold
actions.acting: brow -0.5 to +0.5; he rubs his hands with eyes shut and misses it

scenes.summary: Her two questions: how do you buy what you have not seen, and why would anything valuable sell so cheap? His smile fades.

camera.notes: Slow push from zoom 1.25 to 1.6 centred x 560, y 690 over the speech, keeping both faces and the bundle in frame.

scenes.composition: Wife steps to x 660; bundle between them at x 520; buyer at x 360. Her icon balloon (300 x 220) sits top right at (760, 330); the ? on the bundle is drawn on the bundle itself.

actions.action: Steps forward, hands on hips
actions.acting: one firm step with a settle; chin down, eyes on him

actions.action: Speaks, pointing at him
actions.acting: talk 0.8, brow 0.4, head pushing forward on the stresses

actions.action: Still smiling, he nods along
actions.acting: the nod slows down

actions.action: Her finger swings down to the bundle
actions.acting: gaze follows her own finger

actions.action: A big ? pops on the side of the bundle
actions.acting: the ? rocks once

actions.action: Raps the bundle twice with her knuckles; it gives a soft, flat wobble
actions.acting: buyer blinks twice; his smile closes to a line

actions.action: Turns both palms up in a shrug, head tilted
actions.acting: brows up, a real question

actions.action: Her balloon shows the seller as a black silhouette with a fez-wearing monkey shape on its shoulder
actions.acting: buyer looks up at it and swallows

actions.action: In the balloon a price tag with 3 and a down arrow pulses
actions.acting: buyer eyes slide to the bundle

actions.action: The balloon shows a gem with a ?; he gulps, one sweat drop, and his hands tighten on his sash
actions.acting: smile gone, brow worried (-0.6), gaze stuck on the bundle

scenes.summary: She sees the trick and warns him off stolen or unknown goods.

camera.notes: Zoom 1.6 on the wife and the bundle (centre x 600, y 700); at 150.2 ease back to the two-shot (zoom 1.3) for the warning so his reaction reads.

scenes.composition: Wife at x 660 bends to the bundle at x 520. Buyer at x 360. Warning icons appear in one balloon top centre (500, 300), one after the other.

actions.action: Narrows her eyes at the fancy knot; her pupils jump knot, fringe, husband, knot
actions.acting: lid 0.4, saccades, then brows up: she has it

actions.action: Lifts one corner of the rich cloth with two fingers
actions.acting: careful, as if it might bite

actions.action: A patched grey sleeve flops out of the lifted corner
actions.acting: sleeve swings and hangs

actions.action: Stamp 'A TRICK!' top left
actions.acting: buyer double take: head back, both hands to his head

actions.action: Wags a finger at him, three beats
actions.acting: stern brow 0.6, talk on; he shrinks: sq 0.93, tip -0.06, hands to his cheeks

actions.action: Looks at the three empty fingers that held his coins
actions.acting: slow blink; wet eyes

actions.action: Balloon icon 1: a hand grabbing a bundle, crossed by a red X
actions.acting: she taps the air on the word

actions.action: Balloon icon 2: a wrapped parcel with a ?, crossed by a red X
actions.acting: he nods small and ashamed

actions.action: His head drops and his eyes go to the bundle
actions.acting: shoulders down with a settle

scenes.summary: Far away the thief walks off with the money and his monkey.

camera.notes: Track right with the thief at zoom 1.3, y 700; an iris closes on the waving monkey from 159.9 to 160.4.

scenes.composition: Open road at dusk (Library sky, hill trees, ground at y 900). Thief walks from x 250 to x 720 (s 1.25), monkey on his right shoulder. Coins arc 120 units above his hand.

actions.action: Cut to a dusk road outside the town; the market domes are small on the horizon behind
actions.acting: long shadow under the walker

actions.action: Strolls along with the same lazy walk as at 1.18
actions.acting: smirk, lid 0.45, humming (mouth o pulses)

actions.action: He tosses the three coins and catches them one by one
actions.acting: pupils follow the top coin; hand dips on each catch

actions.action: Pockets the coins and walks on without looking back
actions.acting: pats the pocket twice

actions.action: On his shoulder the monkey turns to camera, tips its fez and waves goodbye as the iris closes
actions.acting: smirk, tail curling

scenes.summary: The buyer opens the fancy cloth at last: old clothes. PAID 3, WORTH 0. Held ending and THE END.

camera.notes: Zoom 1.4 centred x 480, y 720 on the buyer and the table; slow push to 1.6 by 166.8; ease back to 1.2 for THE END at 168.2.

scenes.composition: Buyer at x 400 behind the table (x 520); wife at x 720 with folded arms, in frame the whole time. Box with the two counters top right. THE END on the top band, clear of both heads.

actions.action: Alone at the table he slowly unties the gold cord
actions.acting: worried brow, lid 0.3; fingers hesitate once

actions.action: Behind him his wife watches with folded arms
actions.acting: gaze on his hands, one slow blink

actions.action: The rich corners fall open one by one
actions.acting: open 0 to 1 with follow-through on the tassel

actions.action: The same drab, patched heap; a third moth flutters out
actions.acting: he flinches at the moth

actions.action: Lifts the holed shirt with two fingers and looks through the hole at his wife
actions.acting: the exact pose of the thief at 70.86 (setup and payoff); his eye in the hole

actions.action: Box with two counters: 'PAID: 3' then 'WORTH: 0'
actions.acting: the 0 gives the same sad bounce as SOLD: 0 at 34.14

actions.action: Sinks onto the stool with the shirt in his lap and puts a hand to his head
actions.acting: looks up at his wife, then his eyes break away and his head drops (shame ending)

actions.action: She shakes her head once, then lays a hand on his shoulder
actions.acting: stern brow softens to level; no gloating

actions.action: 'THE END' pops on the top band and holds to the last frame
actions.acting: both figures keep breathing and blinking under it; the shirt sleeve swings to rest

ending.description: After the last word (167.44) the buyer sits slumped with the holed shirt in his lap; his wife shakes her head once and puts a hand on his shoulder. 'THE END' pops on the top band at 168.2 with a quiet chime at 168.5 and holds to 171.43 while both keep breathing and blinking.

subtitles.ar: كان في مدينة رجل يعيش من السرقة،|وله قرد علمه أن يؤدي حركات مضحكة أمام الناس.|اعتاد الرجل الذهاب إلى الأسواق،|وكان يستعمل القرد ليشغل الناس بينما يبحث عن فرصة للسرقة.
subtitles.en: In a city lived a thief|with a trained monkey that performed amusing tricks.|He used it to distract marketgoers|while looking for a chance to steal.

subtitles.ar: وفي يوم رأى بائعًا يحمل ملابس قديمة مستعملة.|نادى البائع على بضاعته طويلًا، لكن أحدًا لم يرغب في شرائها.|تعب أخيرًا، فجمع الملابس في صرة وجلس ليستريح.
subtitles.en: One day he saw a seller offering old, worn clothes.|No one wanted them,|and the weary seller wrapped the clothes in a bundle and sat to rest.

subtitles.ar: اقترب اللص من البائع وجعل القرد يقفز ويلعب أمامه.|ضحك البائع، وصار يتابع حركات الحيوان باهتمام.|وفي تلك اللحظة مد اللص يده وأخذ صرة الملابس من دون أن ينتبه الرجل.
subtitles.en: The thief made his monkey leap and play before the seller.|While the seller watched, amused,|the thief quietly stole the bundle.

subtitles.ar: أخذ اللص القرد والصرة إلى مكان خال.|فتحها ورأى الملابس البالية،|ثم جمعها من جديد داخل قطعة قماش جميلة غالية الثمن،|حتى يبدو ما بداخلها أثمن مما هو في الحقيقة.
subtitles.en: The thief carried the monkey and bundle to a secluded spot.|He rewrapped the rags|in costly, beautiful fabric|to make the contents seem valuable.

subtitles.ar: ذهب إلى سوق آخر وعرض الصرة للبيع بسعر منخفض.|وضع شرطًا غريبًا: لا يجوز للمشتري فتحها قبل دفع المال.|كان يريد أن يظن الناس أن بداخلها شيئًا ثمينًا جدًا.
subtitles.en: In another market he offered the bundle cheaply,|with one strange condition: the buyer must not open it before paying.|He wanted people to imagine valuable contents.

subtitles.ar: رأى رجل قطعة القماش الجميلة، فأعجبته وفكر أنه وجد صفقة رائعة.|اشترى الصرة من غير أن يفحص ما فيها،|وأخذها إلى بيته وهو يتوقع أن يبيعها بربح كبير.
subtitles.en: A buyer admired the elegant wrapping, thought it a bargain,|and purchased it without inspecting it,|hoping to resell at a profit.

subtitles.ar: سألته زوجته عما اشترى،|فأخبرها عن الثمن القليل والربح الذي ينتظره.|قالت: «كيف تشتري شيئًا لا تعرف ما بداخله؟|ولماذا يبيعه صاحبه بهذا الرخص إذا كان ذا قيمة؟»
subtitles.en: His wife asked about the purchase.|Hearing of the low price and hoped-for profit,|she asked why he bought an unopened parcel|and why anything valuable would be sold so cheaply.

subtitles.ar: فهمت الزوجة أن وراء الصفقة خدعة،|وحذرته من شراء الأشياء المسروقة أو المجهولة.|أما اللص فقد أخذ المال ورحل مع قرده،|وبقي المشتري مع صرة من ملابس قديمة لا تستحق ما دفعه.
subtitles.en: She recognized the trick|and warned him against stolen or unknown goods.|The thief left with the money and monkey,|while the buyer remained with old clothes worth less than he had paid.

new_assets.name: marketStreet
new_assets.description: The planned market street (already requested by six stories), here with variants A and B, an alley option and a house-front end. See sets marketA, marketB, alley.
new_assets.implementation: One function marketStreet(ctx, {w, variant, alley, stalls:[{x, kind, cols}], dome, palm, door}) baked once per variant with bake(). Houses are K rectangles with brush outlines and red dot shading; arches by arc paths; awnings as striped polygons with a scalloped edge; goods as simple circles (fruit), trapezoids (pots) and folded rectangles (cloth). Sky is drawn live with skyCycle behind the baked layer (bake the street with a transparent sky).

new_assets.name: palaceHall (variant merchantHouse)
new_assets.description: The planned arched interior in its modest merchant variant: wall, window, door, shelf, tiled floor, low table, stools. See set home.
new_assets.implementation: Baked layer: wall fill with dotPat shading, arch outline, window with a skyCycle-coloured pane, floor tiles as a perspective-free grid of 100-unit squares, table and shelf as rectangles; seatStool() from the Library for the stools.

new_assets.name: clothBundle (with oldClothes and richCloth)
new_assets.description: Knotted cloth bundle with plain and rich wraps, an open state, rags or treasure contents and a peek corner; includes the loose shirt and the flat rich cloth. The heart of the story.
new_assets.implementation: Closed: an ellipse body (150 x 100) with 3 crease strokes and a knot of two leaf shapes; pattern drawn clipped to the body. open 0..1: body flattens to a 260 x 30 cloth while 4 corner triangles rotate down in turn (stagger 0.15); contents drawn between back and front passes. Rags are 5 rounded rectangles in grey, brown and dull green with patch squares and a hole (evenodd clip) on the shirt.

new_assets.name: coinPile
new_assets.description: Planned coin mound with removable single coins (3 coins, heaps of 10 and 30).
new_assets.implementation: Coins as discs stacked in seeded rows (K.rng for offsets); a coin in flight is the same disc on a hop-style arc with a width squeeze for the spin.

new_assets.name: noPeekSign
new_assets.description: Sign board with a crossed-out eye and NO PEEKING!; flips from blank to front.
new_assets.implementation: Rectangle on a post; flip by scaling x through 0; eye as two arcs and a disc, red bar as a rotated rectangle; text with the style label font.

new_assets.name: monkey rot (flip, handstand) and fez
new_assets.description: An optional rot field (radians about the body centre, about 90 units above the feet) for back flips, cartwheels and handstands, and an optional hat:"fez" drawn on the head. Off by default so the regression test stays identical.
new_assets.implementation: In the story first: wrap the monkey() call in ctx.translate/rotate about (x, y - 90*s); for the handstand add hop() to y so the hands meet the ground. Fez: red trapezoid 34 x 26 with a yellow tassel line that lags by 2 frames using swing().

new_assets.name: iconBalloon
new_assets.description: The planned wordless picture balloon (single mode) for the buyer boast (3 coins, coin heap) and the wife questions and warning (seller silhouette, price tag, gem with ?, two crossed-out icons).
new_assets.implementation: Library bubble() outline at a fixed size with a tail to the speaker; the icon is a small draw callback clipped inside; pop in with a 2-frame overshoot.

new_assets.name: inset circle
new_assets.description: The planned round picture-in-picture with an iris, used once (80.58 to 83.2) as a cutaway on the bundle showing the rags inside, and as the closing iris of S16.
new_assets.implementation: ctx.save, arc clip with radius eased 0 to 90, draw the open-bundle contents at 0.8 scale, restore, then a fat brush ring.

new_assets.name: moth
new_assets.description: Tiny fluttering moth on a seeded zigzag path, the running gag for old clothes.
new_assets.implementation: Two triangles whose width follows abs(sin(t*75)); position = start + kfn path + K.noise wobble.

new_assets.name: sneak
new_assets.description: The planned tiptoe option for walk(): high knees, a short hold on each toe. Used 60.5 to 61.5 for four steps.
new_assets.implementation: Drive the person ph from a stepped position function (four eased segments with 0.08 s holds) and add 6 units of body lift per step.

owner_questions: The thief is shown unmasked (red cap, black tunic) with a 'THIEF' label instead of the masked striped thief of the Moonbeam film; default: unmasked.
The monkey wears a small red fez as its performer mark; default: yes.

English lettering added beyond the script: OLD CLOTHES!, SWIPE!, RAGS!?, OUTSIDE: FANCY, INSIDE: RAGS, ANOTHER MARKET, ONLY 3 COINS, NO PEEKING!, NOT CHECKED, A TRICK!, PAID: 3 WORTH: 0, SOLD: 0, HA HA!; default: all kept (the animator may drop SWIPE! and OUTSIDE: FANCY if the frame is crowded).
The price is shown as 3 coins (the script only says a low price) and the buyer dreams of 30; default: 3 and 30.
A moth flies out of the old clothes three times as a running gag (not in the script); default: kept.
The buyer opens the bundle on screen at the end (the script says only that he was left with old clothes); default: he opens it, with his wife present.
No written moral line at the end, only THE END; default: no moral line.
In S1 and S2 the thief only eyes and reaches toward purses and no theft from the crowd is shown (the script says he looked for a chance); default: no theft shown there.
implementation_notes: Start from Library/template; world height 1230, ground y 900; marketStreet worlds are 1800 wide, so clamp the camera x to the world width used by each scene.

The person figure is front-facing only: stage every exchange side by side and show direction with gaze, tip, lean and hand targets. Walks across the frame use walk() and footfalls() on a position function.

The core staging rule of S5 and S6: thief on screen-left, bundle left of the seller, monkey on screen-right. Keep it in every frame of those scenes; the seller's gaze is driven by look() on the monkey position.
Mask on / mask off for the thief: friendly face only while a victim is looking at him; switch on the cue words given (50.70, 98.86).

Setup and payoff pairs to keep identical: the two-finger signal (14.66 and 45.02), the holed shirt held with two fingers (70.86 thief, 164.50 buyer), the sad counter bounce (34.14 and 165.80), the lazy stroll (1.18 and 156.52).

Thought clouds (thoughtCloud): three uses, all narrated thoughts (100.52 the crowd, 111.56 and 122.22 the buyer). Keep figures inside at least 110 px tall on screen; scale about 0.5 with at set to the bundle.
The 'LATER...' card at 84.0 hides the cut from the alley to Market B; put the camera cut at the card's covered midpoint.
Set LIFE.t = t each frame for auto-blinks; give explicit lid values the hand blinks listed in the actions. No blink for the thief from 55.5 to 58.2.
Sound effects only at the listed times (3.9, 21.05, 41.9, 63.35, 68.75, 167.75, 168.5), all in narration pauses, master 0.6. No coin or laugh sounds under speech.
Lettering never covers a face: use the top band (y 80..230 of the panel) or the free side of the frame. Headlines at least 44 px and labels at least 28 px on the 1280 x 720 scale.
Subtitles: chunk boundaries are given in subtitles; time each chunk from its first word to the next chunk first word using timing.json.
Panel-only shake is not needed in this film; do not add camera shake.
warnings: Many human figures: up to 6 on screen in S1, S2 and S9. Keep extras at 3 to 5, reuse the same five, and drop them from close shots.

P4 ends and P5 starts at 84.08 with no pause, so the LATER card overlaps the first word of P5 (the long word at 84.08); the picture of Market B must be clear by 85.6, before the word for market at 86.38.
The word at 57.56 (the thief) has an interpolated time in the timeline; the reach is cued on the neighbouring words 56.48 and 57.56 instead.
The narration has only five pauses of 0.6 s or more, so the film has very few sound effects by design.
marketStreet and palaceHall are shared planned assets: build them to the generic descriptions in production/planned_assets.md so other films can use them.
